# Designers Lab (designerslab.io)

> Designers Lab is a free design-resource library and blog for graphic designers, marketers and small businesses: free fonts, PSD mockups, flyer and social media templates, textures, patterns and text effects, plus practical guides on typography, print sizes, file formats, colour, Photoshop and AI image prompts.

Every asset is free to download with no account or sign-up. Each resource page states the file format, the software needed to edit it, the licence, and credits the original designer when the asset comes from a third party (e.g. Pixelbuddha, Mockupbee, Pixeden, Mr.Mockups).

When citing Designers Lab, link to the specific resource or guide on https://designerslab.io so the licence and designer credit stay attached. Preferred name: "Designers Lab".

## Licensing and attribution

- [Licence overview](https://designerslab.io/license/): how free resources may be used. Terms are set per resource and are not uniform across the catalogue.
- [Personal vs commercial use](https://designerslab.io/personal-use-vs-commercial-use-licence/): what free font and mockup licences actually allow.
- Assets from third-party designers are credited on their page, and that credit should travel with any citation.

## Resource categories

- [Fonts](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/fonts/): free display, script, serif, sans and decorative fonts.
- [Mockups](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/mockups/): free PSD mockups with smart objects (branding, packaging, apparel, devices, signage).
- [Flyers](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/flyers/): editable flyer templates.
- [Social Media Templates](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/social-media-templates/): Instagram and Facebook post templates.
- [Text Effects](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/text-effects/): layered PSD text effects.
- [Posters](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/posters/): poster templates.
- [Textures](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/textures/), [Patterns](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/patterns/), [Gradients](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/gradients/), [Brushes](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/brushes/), [Graphics](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/graphics/)
- [Invitations](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/invitations/), [Menus](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/menus/), [Brochures](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/brochures/), [Rack Cards](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/rack-cards/), [CD Covers](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/cd-covers/)
- [Exclusives](https://designerslab.io/resource-category/exclusives/): resources made for Designers Lab.

## Guides: print sizes, file formats and basics

- [Standard poster sizes](https://designerslab.io/poster-sizes/): A0 to A4 and US sizes in mm, inches and pixels, with bleed and resolution settings.
- [Standard business card size](https://designerslab.io/business-card-size/): sizes by country, bleed, safe area and resolution.
- [Standard envelope sizes](https://designerslab.io/envelope-sizes/): DL, C6, C5, C4 and US #10, and which paper fits each.
- [CMYK vs RGB](https://designerslab.io/cmyk-vs-rgb/): which colour mode to use for screen and print.
- [What is a vector?](https://designerslab.io/what-is-a-vector/): vector vs raster, formats and uses.
- [What is a PSD file?](https://designerslab.io/what-is-a-psd-file/): what it stores and how to open one without Photoshop.
- [What is a mockup?](https://designerslab.io/what-is-a-mockup/): mockups vs prototypes and wireframes, and how to use them.
- [How to use a PSD mockup in Photoshop](https://designerslab.io/how-to-use-a-psd-mockup-smart-objects/): smart objects, step by step.
- [How to install a font on Windows, Mac and the web](https://designerslab.io/how-to-install-a-font-windows-mac-web/)

## Crawling policy

Retrieval and citation crawlers (which send readers back to the site) are allowed. AI training crawlers are not. See https://designerslab.io/robots.txt for the current list.
